name: noto-mode
description: Approves the permission prompts auto mode would skip (read-only actions, edits in the project, a classifier for the rest) and explains every prompt that still reaches you.

classifier.title: Use a model classifier
classifier.description: Judge gray-area calls (most shell commands, MCP tools) with a small model, as auto mode does. Off: those calls prompt you as before.

model.title: Classifier model
model.description: An alias (haiku, sonnet) or a full model id for the classifier.

timeoutMs.title: Classifier timeout (ms)
timeoutMs.description: How long one classifier call may take before the prompt is shown instead.

quiet.title: Quiet
quiet.description: No toasts when the classifier approves a call. The status line and /noto-mode still report.
